title: Chama Trust Circle
description: A fictional group weighs savings, a reserve and requests using transparent token accounts.
learning_objectives: Distinguish the group pool from the amount available to lend.
Calculate a simple fictional percentage fee and total due.
Explain how a reserve changes the group's choices under uncertainty.

2.label: Reserve funds cannot be lent now

en: The group pool and the protected reserve are different amounts.
A loan adds a repayment due later; it is not new group income.
Compare amount lent, amount due and the event's payment capacity.
sw: Mfuko na akiba iliyotengwa ni kiasi tofauti.
Mkopo huongeza malipo ya baadaye; si mapato mapya ya kikundi.
Linganisha mkopo, kiasi cha kulipa na uwezo wa tukio.
